name: Spire Ledger
author: MokoGuy (fork of Damage Charts by zaxnyd)
description: Incoming-damage forecast and damage analytics: see how much HP you're about to lose this turn (docked beside your character), plus a hotkey-toggled (default C) breakdown of damage dealt and taken by source, potions used, an end-of-combat summary and a run recap. Uses the game's own look. Single-player and multiplayer.
